title: tpu-sharding Researcher Request
description: Delegation payload from optimizer to tpu-sharding-researcher for broad search.

iteration.description: Current iteration index triggering broad search.

state_artifact.description: Relative artifact path to state.json ledger (e.g., 'state.json').

profiling_report_artifacts.description: List of relative artifact paths to XProf profiling reports to inspect (e.g., ['0/tpu_profiling_report.md', '1/tpu_profiling_report.md']).

optimization_constraints.description: Hard bounds and constraints to respect during search (e.g., 'Sequence length must be fixed at 2048.').

examples.optimization_constraints: Sequence length must be fixed at 2048.
